title.en: Agents you installed with npm update at their original install path
title.zh: 通过 npm 自行安装的智能体按原安装路径更新

description.en: Agents installed with npm are now updated in place instead of getting a second copy in ~/.openagents. If the path requires administrator rights, macOS asks for authorization; on Windows and Linux the command to run is shown. Agents installed other ways (such as Homebrew or an official install script) still get a new copy in ~/.openagents for workspaces to use, and the original install is left unchanged.
description.zh: 通过 npm 自行安装的智能体，更新时直接在原安装路径中进行，不再在 ~/.openagents 下另装一份。路径需要管理员权限时，macOS 会请求系统授权，Windows 和 Linux 会给出需执行的命令。通过其他方式（如 Homebrew 或官方安装脚本）安装的，更新时仍会在 ~/.openagents 下另装一份新版本供工作区使用，原安装保持不变。

title.zh: 工作区设置打开不再卡顿

description.en: Settings no longer reload on every section switch, and returning to the workspace no longer reloads it from scratch.
description.zh: 切换设置分区时不再重新加载，返回工作区时也不再重新加载整个工作区。
